title: This Tiny 30-Gram Fossil Animal Lived 18 Million Years Ago and Changed What Scientists Knew About the Marsupial Family Tree
description: A tiny fossil from Australia has surprised scientists with a discovery hidden in its remains for millions of years.

title: Ancient monastery in Thailand added to Unesco heritage list
description: A centuries-old monastery in southern Thailand is the country's latest cultural landmark to be inscribed on Unesco's World Heritage List, which will aid in the site's conservation.

title: Angola's oldest burials, including its only known ancient cremation, uncovered at a 15th-century site doomed by a dam
description: As the construction of a hydroelectric dam loomed, archaeologists raced to uncover Angola's earliest dated burials and its only known cremation at a 15th-century settlement before it vanished beneath the water.
